title: Hearing is Believing? Evaluating and Analyzing Audio Language Model Sycophancy with SYAUDIO
reasoning: The paper introduces the SYAUDIO benchmark, which explicitly includes 'Audio Ethics' as one of its four core evaluation domains. It specifically utilizes the 'moral' subset of the MMLU dataset, converted to audio via text-to-speech, to evaluate how sycophancy impacts ethical and moral reasoning in audio language models.
